notes: Input study identifiers, neutral description and locators are empty. Named replication final report identifies coded claim 4 as original Table 4 public-treatment coefficient −18.12 (robust SE 8.17), p=0.030; this independently identifies the target. Original coefficient retained as printed; no t statistic computed from coefficient/SE. Final report was obtained from the supplied URL as an OSF file download (https://osf.io/download/n6jca/), linked in the reference project vg6zy. The initially obtained SCORE report f8y6n is an unfilled template and was not used for replication statistics. Final report prints inconsistent regression statistics: F(1,126)=0.017, unstandardized B=57.5921 and SE=4.481941, versus primary regression PDF residual df 526, B=575.921, SE=4481.941. Primary PDF values retained as printed. Final report describes dummy coding as 0=anonymous,1=disclosed and a negative mean difference, but primary regression coefficient is positive, and t-test PDF prints anonymous/disclosed means 110083.64/109507.72. Coding/direction inconsistency unresolved; no sign correction or conversion made. Primary regression output additionally prints standardized Beta=.006 and F=.017, p=.898. Original n is the target cell sample, not the full MBA sample; replication n is verified in target analysis output, not only a generic report total.
